policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: Qere וָאֵ֣רֶא and ketiv ואראה are the same verb, wayyiqtol 1cs of ראה 'and I saw', differing only in the final mater; ASV 'when I saw among the spoil' renders that verb identically under either spelling. The only note on JOS.7.21 is a hebrew_gloss on 'Babylonish mantle' (Hebrew mantle of Shinar), which is unrelated to this lemma and is not a textual note. Nothing in the ASV distinguishes the readings, so both stand and the qere base fallback carries the projection.
